intro.text: A city on Roshar, famous enough to be talked about even in rural Alethkar.
An island city in Rira, known as the City of Lightning, and the site of one of the ten Oathgates linked to Urithiru.

description.text: As a boy, Kaladin heard tales of Kurth, Rall Elorim and other exotic places, and they fed his wish to see other lands.

Kurth lies on the west side of a Reshi Sea island just off the Riran mainland, in northwestern Roshar. In the age of the Silver Kingdoms it was the capital of Rishir; today its island belongs to Rira rather than to the Reshi Isles.

items.text: As Dalinar's coalition took shape after the Everstorm, its members hoped to open and hold Kurth's Oathgate, but Rira never answered Dalinar's approaches. The Iriali, who count Rira as a vassal, refused to deal with him, resenting that he had married Evi after she left Rira bringing a set of Shardplate with her. Rira and Iri sided with Odium's forces.
